meta.author: Paul Koller
meta.description: Released as a playable demo in 2010, VVVVVV is a Commodore 64 adaptation of Terry Cavanagh's minimalist platform game. Created by Paul Koller, it recreates the original's gravity-flipping gameplay within the constraints of the C64 hardware. This early version includes the core game mechanics and several of the original levels, accompanied by a chiptune soundtrack adapted for the Commodore 64.
